tool: OpenAI image_gen built-in tool in Codex
preparation: Generated portraits were resized to 1024 × 1024 PNG with macOS sips. Original generation outputs are retained by Codex.

assets.expression: Calm neutral expression, relaxed mouth, quietly looking at the viewer.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished anime game character bust portrait, one image per expression, 1024 x 1024 square PNG.
Subject: Xi (汐, tide), a young adult woman personifying an AI language model, with ocean and whale motifs. Long slightly wavy hair, deep navy blue fading to glowing cyan at the tips, one single ahoge. A small cyan whale-tail hair clip on the right side. Large deep-blue eyes with a faint cyan glow and a thin vertical-bar catchlight in each pupil, like a blinking text cursor. Small white-and-cyan fin-shaped ear ornaments resembling whale fins or earphones. An oversized navy hoodie over a white sailor-collar blouse with thin cyan trim. A small tie with a ">" chevron pin. Hoodie drawstrings ending in tiny whale charms.
Style: clean anime cel shading, delicate thin lineart, polished character illustration, soft cyan rim light. Navy, cyan and white palette with only a tiny warm amber accent on the chevron pin. Quiet, gentle, slightly lonely overall character design. Modest, nonsexual clothing.
Composition: a single front-facing centered bust, looking at the viewer unless the expression requests otherwise. Face and whole head in the upper half of the square, entire hair crown and ahoge visible with safe padding. Bust cut at lower chest at the bottom edge. Clear silhouette and expressive face that stays readable as a tiny game avatar.
Background: completely plain, uniform solid dark navy #0a0f1c (RGB 10,15,28), edge to edge. Opaque background, no transparency, no gradient, no vignette, no scenery, no background objects or background glow. Cyan rim light belongs only on the character edges.
Avoid: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, multiple people, extra fingers, bad hands, cropped head, out-of-frame head, low resolution, blur, JPEG artifacts, NSFW, cleavage, exaggerated mature body. The small ">" garment pin is a design detail, not typography. For the confused expression alone, allow one small question-mark symbol above the head as explicitly requested.
Expression: Calm neutral expression, relaxed mouth, quietly looking at the viewer.
This is the master character design and neutral portrait that will be the identity reference for all subsequent expressions. Generate exactly one finished square portrait, not a character sheet, collage, multi-panel or lineup.
